svg.title: DataOps Lakehouse — C4 container view
svg.desc: C4 container diagram. Operational plane (Docker Compose): the marketplace team uses the React Control Tower, which calls the FastAPI backend; marketplace exports enter through POST /imports and are gated row by row by Great Expectations contracts inside the API, which also validate the books in PostgreSQL 16, the system of record; a batch job writes revenue forecasts. The 1M-row CSV seeds PostgreSQL and is uploaded to a Unity Catalog volume. Analytical plane (Databricks): a Workflows job runs Landing, Bronze, Silver, the fail-fast DQ gate R1–R9 and Gold; Gold feeds AI/BI dashboards and Genie, explored by the data analyst, and MLflow experiments; the API asks the Foundation Model API for document answers. Delivery (GitHub): CI runs 10 jobs on every pull request, CD on a v* tag deploys and validates Gold, Terraform provisions the workspace assets, and mise + uv run every task locally.
